parts.name: Body
parts.Basic_description: The body is the main cylindrical part of the bottle made of PET plastic, forming the largest volume for holding liquid.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for storing liquids, providing structural integrity and volume capacity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part that does not move; it supports the neck and lid and is grasped during use.

parts.name: Neck
parts.Basic_description: The neck is the narrow upper section of the bottle made of PET plastic, connecting the body to the lid.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a threaded or fitted interface for the lid, allowing the bottle to be sealed or opened.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part that does not move independently but interacts with the lid during opening and closing.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a small, detachable cap made of polypropylene that fits onto the neck of the bottle.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the bottle to prevent leakage and contamination, and can be twisted or snapped on and off.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or snap on/off the neck, allowing the user to open or close the bottle.
